integrations.how.title: How to add a key
integrations.how.1: Get the value from the service (the card tells you where).
integrations.how.2: Add it under its exact name in Vercel: Settings, Environment Variables. Choose Secret for secrets. For local work, put it in .env.local.
integrations.how.3: Redeploy, then press Re-check. The status turns to Set. We never see or store the value.
integrations.how.warn: Never paste a key into chat, email or a form. If one leaks, rotate it in the service straight away.
